name: Cheerwin Group Limited
summary: Cheerwin Group Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and trades household insecticides and repellents, household cleaning, air care, personal care, pet stores and pet products, and other products in the People's Republic of China. The company offers plastic daily cleaning products and auto accessories; pets and pet products; baby and personal care products; testing, consultation, and marketing services. It also provides its products under the Vewin, Superb, Babeking, Naughty Buddy, Naughty Mouth, Cyrin, Rikiso, Zhuazhua Cat Planet, and Mele Family brand names.
